public_behavior: The public docs describe API-format workflows as JSON node graphs with input/output connections that can be submitted programmatically.
input_output_observed: A validated workflow definition can be sent to a local ComfyUI server to request processing; output structure depends on the configured graph.
unknowns: The exact model, custom-node behavior, licensing, GPU demand and output quality depend on the installed workflow and are not determined by the API schema alone.
